## Backend API Endpoints (autogenerated)

This file lists backend API endpoints discovered in `backend/app/api` and `backend/app/api/v1`.
For v1 routers the prefix used by the app is assumed to be `/api/v1`.

Note: `get_current_user` indicates authenticated access; `require_admin` indicates admin-only.

---

**Auth & User**
- POST `/api/auth/register` — Request: `UserCreate` → Response: `TokenResponse` — Register new user, returns token. Access: public (creates user, first user becomes admin implicitly).
- POST `/api/auth/login` — Request: `UserLogin` → Response: `TokenResponse` — Login, returns token. Access: public.
- GET `/api/auth/me` — Response: `UserResponse` — Get current user profile. Access: authenticated.
- PUT `/api/auth/me` — Request: `MeUpdate` → Response: `UserResponse` — Update own profile (username/full_name/password). Access: authenticated.
- DELETE `/api/auth/me` — Response: {message} — Delete own account. Access: authenticated.

**Chat / AI Gateway (top-level)**
- POST `/api/chat` — Request: `ChatRequest {message, session_id?, model?}` → Response: `ChatResponse {session_id, query, response, execution_id?, routing_info?}` — Route a chat query through AI gateway. Access: public.

**Memory & Vault (top-level)**
- GET `/api/memory` — Query params: `limit` → Response: {timestamp,count,categories,entries[]} — Read public and user-specific knowledge entries; returns entries visible to requester. Access: optional auth (public or authenticated). 
- POST `/api/memory` — Request: `MemoryCreatePayload {title,content,category,source_path?}` → Response: {status, entry} — Store a memory entry (associated to user if authenticated). Access: optional auth.
- GET `/api/vault` — Response: vault metadata (locked/encrypted/path/categories) — Shows vault status; Access: optional auth.
- POST `/api/vault` — Request: `VaultUnlockPayload {password}` → Response: vault payload unlocked — Unlock vault with user password; Access: authenticated.

**System & Health (top-level / v1)**
- GET `/api/system/status` — Response: system metrics (cpu/ram/load/processes/health) — Access: public.
- GET `/api/system/logs` — Response: recent logs — Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/health/live` — Response: {status: "alive"} — Liveness probe. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/health/ready` — Response: {status,database} — Readiness probe. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/health/deep` — Response: deep health checks (database,memory,rag). Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/health/services` — Response: list of managed service statuses. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/health/services/{name}/restart` — Body: none → Response: {message} — Restart certain internal services (Sync Engine, Observer, DB engine); Access: public (but may be effectively admin-only in practice).

**Model Control (top-level & v1 models router)**
- GET `/api/models/local` — Response: list of local models and status. Access: public.
- POST `/api/models/download` — Request: `DownloadRequest {model}` → Response: download job start. Access: public.
- GET `/api/models/downloads` — Response: list of download jobs. Access: public.
- GET `/api/models/config` — Response: model control config. Access: public.
- PUT `/api/models/config` — Request: dict config → Response: updated config. Access: public.

**v1/models (mounted at `/api/v1/models`)**
- GET `/api/v1/models` — Response: list all models (local & cloud). Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/models/by-type/{model_type}` — Path param: `model_type` (local|cloud|custom) → Response: filtered models. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/models/providers` — Response: configured providers. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/models/providers/validate` — Request: `ValidatePayload` → Response: validation result. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/models/providers/{provider_name}/models` — Response: provider models. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/models/providers` — Request: `ProviderPayload` → Response: created provider. Access: public (requires validation if enabled).
- PUT `/api/v1/models/providers/{provider_name}` — Request: `ProviderPayload` → Response: updated provider. Access: public.
- PUT `/api/v1/models/providers/{provider_name}/default-model` — Request: `DefaultModelPayload` → Response: updated default. Access: public.
- DELETE `/api/v1/models/providers/{provider_name}` — Response: deletion result. Access: public.

- GET `/api/v1/models/custom` — Response: list custom models. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/models/custom` — Request: `CustomModelPayload` → Response: created custom model. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/models/custom/{model_name}` — Response: custom model details. Access: public.
- PUT `/api/v1/models/custom/{model_name}` — Request: `CustomModelPayload` → Response: updated model. Access: authenticated.
- DELETE `/api/v1/models/custom/{model_name}` — Response: deletion result. Access: authenticated.
- POST `/api/v1/models/select` — Request: `SelectModelPayload {model_name, session_id?}` → Response: selection state — Persists selection to Redis/DB if authenticated. Access: optional auth.

- GET `/api/v1/models/installed` — Response: installed models (legacy support). Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/models/check/{model_name}` — Response: {installed: bool} — Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/models/pull` — Request: `PullModelPayload {model}` → Response: job — starts download. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/models/downloads` and `/api/v1/models/downloads/{job_id}` — Manage model download jobs. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/models/downloads/{job_id}/cancel|/resume` — Control downloads. Access: public.
- DELETE `/api/v1/models/{model_name}` — Delete installed model (calls Ollama API). Access: authenticated.

- GET `/api/v1/models/routing/profiles` — Response: routing profiles. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/models/routing/profiles/select` — Request: `SelectProfileRequest` → Response: activate profile. Access: authenticated (requires `get_current_user`).
- GET `/api/v1/models/routing/routes` — Response: active routing routes. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/models/routing/routes` — Request: `UpdateRoutesRequest` → Response: activate custom routes. Access: authenticated.

**v1/registry (mounted at `/api/v1/registry`)**
- GET `/api/v1/registry/sync` — Query: `force_refresh?` → Sync registry from Ollama. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/registry/models` — Response: registry models. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/registry/models/installed` — Response: installed models. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/registry/models/by-capability/{capability}` — Filter by capability. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/registry/models/search` — Query params: `q, capability?, family?, size?, limit` → search models. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/registry/models/{model_id}` — Get model metadata. Access: authenticated.
- POST `/api/v1/registry/models/{model_id}/pull` — Start download via registry. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/registry/downloads/{progress_id}` — Check download progress. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/registry/recommendations` — Query: `task` → Get recommended models. Access: authenticated.
- POST `/api/v1/registry/models/{model_id}/mark-installed` — Mark model installed. Access: authenticated.

**v1/sync (mounted at `/api/v1/sync`)**
- GET `/api/v1/sync/status` — Response: sync engine status. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/sync/runs/latest` — Response: latest `SyncRunResponse` or null. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/sync/runs/{run_id}` — Response: `SyncRunResponse`. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/sync/now` — Triggers immediate sync (background) — Request params: `embedding_model?, vector_db?, code_parsing?` → Response: `SyncRunResponse`. Access: optional auth.
- POST `/api/v1/sync/pause|/resume|/cancel` — Control sync. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/sync/force` — Force resync from scratch. Access: optional auth.
- GET `/api/v1/sync/config` — Get sync scope config. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/sync/config/include|/exclude` and `/config/include/remove|/exclude/remove` — Manage include/exclude sync folders. Access: public.

**v1/execution (mounted at `/api/v1/execution`)**
- GET `/api/v1/execution` — Query: `limit` → List executions. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/execution/{execution_id}` — Get execution metadata. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/execution/{execution_id}/replay` — Return step-by-step replay. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/execution/{execution_id}/tools` — Return tools usage for execution. Access: public.

**v1/workspace (mounted at `/api/v1/workspace`)**
- GET `/api/v1/workspace/intelligence` — Returns workspace intelligence report. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/workspace/sync` — Request triggers workspace sync (background) → Response: `SyncRunResponse`. Access: optional auth.

**v1/context (mounted at `/api/v1/context`)**
- POST `/api/v1/context/attach` — Request: `AttachContextRequest` (contains `ContextItem`) → Response: {id,item} — Attach or upsert context item. Access: public.
- DELETE `/api/v1/context/{context_id}` — Delete context item. Access: public.
- PATCH `/api/v1/context/{context_id}` — Patch context item (body: dict). Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/context` — Query: `session_id?` → List context items (optionally session-scoped). Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/context/resolve` — Request: list of context IDs → Response: resolved context. Access: public.

**v1/hierarchical (mounted at `/api/v1/sync/hierarchical`)**
- POST `/api/v1/sync/hierarchical/repo` — Request: `RepoIndexRequest {repo_path}` → Index repository. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/sync/hierarchical/file` — Request: `FileIndexRequest {file_path,repo_path}` → Index a single file. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/sync/hierarchical/search` — Query: `query, top_k` → Search hierarchical memory. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/sync/hierarchical/retrieve_context` — Query: `query` → Retrieve context string. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/sync/hierarchical/expand_graph` — Query: `node_id` → Expand node graph. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/sync/hierarchical/build_context` — Request: `BuildContextRequest {query, history?, user_id?}` → Build context via RAG. Access: public.

**v1/orchestration (mounted at `/api/v1/sync/orchestration`)**
- POST `/api/v1/sync/orchestration/run_task` — Request: `RunTaskRequest` → Execute full orchestration graph and return result summary. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/sync/orchestration/execute_agent` — Request: `ExecuteAgentRequest` → Execute specific agent. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/sync/orchestration/route_task` — Request: `RouteTaskRequest` → Simulate routing; returns best agent and confidence. Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/sync/orchestration/debug_execution_graph` — Query: `query, context?` → Returns planned graph without executing. Access: public.

**v1/ai (mounted at `/api/v1/ai`)**
- POST `/api/v1/ai/ask` — Request: `QueryRequest` → Response: `AIResponse {query,response,execution_id?,routing_info?}` — Public ask endpoint. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/ai/chat` — Request: `QueryRequest` → Response: `AIResponse` — Authenticated chat that saves user context. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/ai/history` — Query: `limit` → Get user's chat history. Access: authenticated.

**v1/intelligence (mounted at `/api/v1/intelligence`)**
- GET `/api/v1/intelligence/settings/automation` — Response: `AutomationSettingsResponse` — Automation/trusted categories. Access: optional auth.
- PUT `/api/v1/intelligence/settings/automation` — Request: `AutomationSettingsUpdate` → Update automation settings. Access: optional auth.
- GET `/api/v1/intelligence/exclusions` — Response: `ExclusionConfigResponse` — Access: public.
- GET `/api/v1/intelligence/memory/search` — Query: `q,limit` → Response: `KnowledgeSearchResponse`. Access: optional auth.
- GET `/api/v1/intelligence/knowledge` — List knowledge entries. Access: optional auth.
- GET `/api/v1/intelligence/repositories` — List repository profiles. Access: optional auth.
- GET `/api/v1/intelligence/proactive` — List proactive notifications. Access: optional auth.
- POST `/api/v1/intelligence/proactive/{notification_id}/dismiss` — Dismiss notification. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/intelligence/actions/plan` — Request: `SystemActionPlanRequest` → Plan system action. Access: optional auth.
- GET `/api/v1/intelligence/actions/pending` — List pending actions. Access: optional auth.
- POST `/api/v1/intelligence/actions/{action_id}/approve` — Approve+execute action. Access: public.
- POST `/api/v1/intelligence/actions/{action_id}/reject` — Reject action. Access: public.

**v1/profile & user settings**
- GET `/api/v1/me/profile` — Response: `UserProfileSchema` — Get current user's profile. Access: authenticated.
- PUT `/api/v1/me/profile` — Request: `UserProfileUpdateSchema` → Update profile. Access: authenticated.
- GET `/api/v1/users/me/settings` — Response: `UserSettingsSchema` — Get current user's settings (masked key). Access: authenticated.
- PUT `/api/v1/users/me/settings` — Request: `UserSettingsUpdateSchema` → Update settings (stores encrypted key). Access: authenticated.

**v1/vault (mounted at `/api/v1/vault`)**
- GET `/api/v1/vault/settings` — Vault settings & category sizes. Access: optional auth.
- POST `/api/v1/vault/change-path` — Request: `ChangePathPayload {path}` → Migrate vault path. Access: optional auth.
- POST `/api/v1/vault/reset` — Reset vault. Access: optional auth.
- GET `/api/v1/vault/export` — Returns zip backup as file. Access: optional auth.
- POST `/api/v1/vault/import` — Upload zip file to restore vault. Access: optional auth.
